subject: Coordinating global Dedicated/Private demo — split sessions to accommodate DPO & APAC security
messages:
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Lena Müller <lena.mueller@novamed.de>, Max Turner <max.turner@stately.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Hiro Tanaka <hiro_tanaka@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 13 Feb 2027 23:05:00 +0000
Subject: Coordinating global Dedicated/Private demo — proposed windows and DPO/APAC security presence

Hi team / Max / Lena / Sandeep (looping early),

Thanks for taking this on — we want to lock a short exec + security walkthrough for the Dedicated/Private deployment plan for Stately AI (RDW-4387). Because we need both the EU DPO (Lena) and APAC security lead (Sandeep) on technical call for the private deployment proof-of-concept, I want to propose a pragmatic approach to avoid a single brutal timezone overlap.

Quick context:
- Goal: 60–75 minute joint session covering network architecture, data flow (KV/cache handling), KMS/HSM options, and audit/logging with room for DPO questions.
- Requirement: Lena (EU DPO) needs an explicit DPO-facing 30 min window in-business-hours CET. Sandeep (APAC security) needs an additional deep-dive on APAC-specific networking and on-prem considerations.

Proposed options (local conversions included) — all in March to give time for Doc review:
1) Two-part plan (recommended):
   - EU/US session: 9 Mar 2027, 14:00–15:15 CET (08:00–09:15 ET / 05:00–06:15 PT) — covers architecture + DPO Q&A.
   - APAC deep dive: 10 Mar 2027, 09:30–11:00 JST (01:30–03:00 CET, 17:30–19:00 ET previous day) — technical deep dive with APAC security.
2) Single extended session (less preferred): 9 Mar 2027, 13:00–15:30 CET — would be early for APAC and late for some US folks.

Notes on DST: US Spring DST starts later in March (Mar 14), EU spring DST is later (Mar 28). That helps us for early March dates — but please flag any customer-side local holidays. APAC participants do not observe DST.

Attachments: calendar_slots.ics (proposed slots), SLA_draft_v2.pdf (for legal), short-runbook.docx (internal).

Action requested:
- Lena: can you confirm whether 9 Mar 14:00–14:30 CET works for an initial DPO slot?
- Sandeep: if APAC requires a different day, note preferred windows (JST/AWST/IST).
- Laura / Marissa / Hiro: any constraints on Redwood side for the proposed windows?

If we can't align a single overlap we'll split into two focused sessions (recommended to keep DPO time efficient).

Thanks — Vivek

--
Vivek Kulkarni
Senior Solutions Lead, Redwood Inference
vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com
(Attachment: calendar_slots.ics)

From: Lena Müller <lena.mueller@novamed.de>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 14 Feb 2027 08:12:00 +01:00
Subject: Re: Coordinating global Dedicated/Private demo — proposed windows and DPO/APAC security presence

Hi Vivek / Laura / Marissa,

Thanks for the clear options. For Novamed's DPO coverage: I can commit to a 30–45 minute DPO Q&A in the morning CET window next week, ideally between 09:30–11:00 CET. The 14:00 CET slot on 9 Mar is a bit late for our legal team that week (they have a roadshow).

Requests before the call:
- Please share the draft data flow diagrams and the sections in SLA_draft_v2 that outline data residency, retention, and log access.
- A short runbook (1 pager) that lists What We Need from the customer (IP allowlist, test tenant, KMS role) would help Lena triage.

I can join either: 9 Mar 09:30–10:15 CET or 10 Mar 09:30–10:15 CET. If you break into two sessions, the earlier slot on 9 Mar works better for me.

Best,
Lena
DPO, Novamed
(Attachment request: data_flow_diagram.svg)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Lena Müller <lena.mueller@novamed.de>
Cc: Hiro Tanaka <hiro_tanaka@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Feb 2027 09:02:00 +00:00
Subject: Re: Coordinating global Dedicated/Private demo — proposed windows and DPO/APAC security presence

On Sun, Feb 14, 2027 at 08:12 +01:00 Lena Müller wrote:
> I can commit to a 30–45 minute DPO Q&A in the morning CET window next week...

Thanks, Lena — helpful. To keep this efficient I'd suggest we split into two short sessions:

Proposal (finalized):
- EU/US session (architecture + DPO Q&A): 9 Mar 2027, 09:30–10:30 CET (08:30–09:30 GMT / 04:30–05:30 ET) — this respects Lena's morning preference and keeps the call no earlier than 04:30 ET for US folks.
- APAC security deep-dive (networking, on-prem options): 10 Mar 2027, 09:30–11:00 JST — focused technical workshop for Sandeep and APAC infra.

If the EU/US time above still looks tight for Redwood engineering, we can nudge to 14:00 CET as a fallback but prefer morning for the DPO.

I'll draft the two calendar invites and include a short agenda + required artifacts. Action items: Vivek, can you confirm owners for the APAC deep-dive slides? Hiro / Soojin, can you coordinate a 20-minute run-through with engineering before the APAC session?

—Marissa
Senior AE, Redwood Inference

From: Hiro Tanaka <hiro_tanaka@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Sandeep Rao <sandeep.rao@orbital-health.in>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Feb 2027 23:48:00 +09:00
Subject: Re: Coordinating global Dedicated/Private demo — proposed windows and DPO/APAC security presence

Hi all,

APAC availability notes from our side: I can staff the APAC deep-dive on 10 Mar 09:30–11:00 JST. For broader APAC attendees: 09:30 JST is mid-morning in Tokyo and a reasonable start time for Australia/India too (no DST complications).

Sandeep — if you want to push earlier (08:30 JST) we can try, but 09:30 gives the on-call infra team time to prepare. Also, if we need any on-prem firewall team on the call, we should lock that in today.

I'll prepare slides on network diagrams + KMS options and coordinate a 20-minute engineering dry-run on 9 Mar 16:00 JST (this is 07:00 CET, so should be OK for a small demo crew).

Thanks — Hiro
Principal Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

From: Sandeep Rao <sandeep.rao@orbital-health.in>
To: Hiro Tanaka <hiro_tanaka@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 16 Feb 2027 00:41:00 +05:30
Subject: Re: Coordinating global Dedicated/Private demo — proposed windows and DPO/APAC security presence

Thanks Hiro / Vivek — 10 Mar 09:30 JST works for me. I'll join with a small infra team (2) to cover on-prem routing and firewall rules.

Pre-call ask: could you share a short security checklist (expected artifacts) and the SLA_draft_v2.pdf sections that reference breach notification and log access? I'm attaching our standard checklist so we can pre-clear items: (Attachment: security_checklist.xlsx).

I'll also loop in an internal cloud ops lead if we need to test firewall whitelists during the dry-run.

Regards,
Sandeep
APAC Security Lead, Orbital Health

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Lena Müller <lena.mueller@novamed.de>, Sandeep Rao <sandeep.rao@orbital-health.in>, Max Turner <max.turner@stately.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Hiro Tanaka <hiro_tanaka@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 16 Feb 2027 10:12:00 +00:00
Subject: Re: Coordinating global Dedicated/Private demo — split sessions confirmed + next steps

Thanks, everyone — good alignment. Final plan and next steps: 

1) EU/US session (DPO-focused) — 9 Mar 2027, 09:30–10:30 CET
   - Agenda: 10m intros, 30m architecture + data flow, 20m DPO Q&A, 10m next steps.
   - Deliverables before call: data_flow_diagram.svg, SLA_draft_v2.pdf section highlights, one-pager runbook (owner: Laura).

2) APAC deep-dive (security/ops) — 10 Mar 2027, 09:30–11:00 JST
   - Agenda: 15m context, 45m networking & on-prem, 20m test plan & firewall checklist, 10m wrap.
   - Deliverables before call: security_checklist.xlsx (Sandeep provided), network slides (owner: Hiro).

Action items (owners):
- Laura: publish one-pager runbook and highlight SLA sections (due 1 Mar).
- Marissa: send calendar invites with agenda + attach SLA_draft_v2.pdf excerpt (today).
- Hiro: prepare network slides + run dry-run 9 Mar 16:00 JST.
- Soojin / Kimberly: be on standby for compliance questions during EU session.

I've created calendar invites and attached calendar_slots.ics and the current SLA draft. If anything changes, I will update and ping here. Deal ID RDW-4387; please add to any notes.

Thanks — Vivek
(Attachment: SLA_draft_v2.pdf, calendar_slots.ics)
